cases.question: Is 2.5% guaranteed every single year?

response.message:
- No, the supplied brochure does not state that 2.5% is credited every single year. [1]
- It states that the Account Value, including credited interest and Extra Bonus, is guaranteed to have accumulated to at least an amount as if the credited interest rate had been 2.5% p.a. [1]
- That guarantee applies to a policy that has been in force for 15 years or more. [1]
- The current assumed base crediting rate of 4.0% and the current assumed retrospective additional interest rate of 0.25% are not guaranteed. [2][1]

cases.question: What are the cooling-off rights?

response.message:
- If you are not satisfied with the Policy, you may return it to the insurer under a signed covering letter within 21 calendar days after delivery of the Policy or delivery of the Notice to you or your representative, whichever is earlier [1].

- The Notice states that the Policy is available for collection and the expiry date of the cooling-off period [1].

- The insurer will cancel the Policy upon receipt of your written request and refund all premiums and the levy you paid, where applicable to Hong Kong only, without interest [1].

- No refund can be made if a benefit payment has been made, is to be made, or is impending [1].

citations.excerpt: Cooling-off Period and Right of Cancellation If you are not satisfied with the Policy, you may return it under a signed covering letter to us (Hong Kong: 27/F, YF Life Tower, 33 Lockhart Road, Wanchai, Hong Kong / Macau: Avenida Doutor Mario Soares No. 320, Finance and IT Center of Macau, 8 Andar A, Macau) within 21 calendar days after the delivery of the Policy or delivery of the Notice (which states that the Policy is available for collection and the expiry date of the cooling-off period) to you or your representative, whichever is earlier. We will cancel the Policy upon receipt of your written request and refund all premiums and the levy you paid (applicable to Hong Kong only), without any interest. No refund can be made if a benefit payment has been made, is to be made or impending.
